chapter.heading: The Confidence of the FoolishTo the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
chapter.v:
Hear this,
all peoples;Give ear, all inhabitants of the world, [Num. 12:6 b 2 Chr. 26–32]

Both low
and high,Rich and poor together. [Jer. 2:12]

My mouth
shall speak wisdom,And the meditation of my heart shall give understanding. [Jer. 8:7 e Jer.]

I will
incline my ear to a proverb;I will disclose my dark saying on the harp. [Is. 57:3, 4; Matt.]

Why should
I fear in the days of evil,When the iniquity at my heels surrounds me? [Jer. 5:3]

Those who
trust in their wealthAnd boast in the multitude of their riches,

None of
them can by any means redeem his brother,Nor give to God a ransom for him— [Deut. 28:51, 52; 2 Chr. 36:19]

For the
redemption of their souls is costly,And it shall cease forever— [Job 27:18 j Jer.]

That he
should continue to live eternally,And not see the Pit.

For he
sees wise men die;Likewise the fool and the senseless person perish,And leave their wealth to others. [Deut. 32:32]

Their inner
thought is that their houses will last forever,Their dwelling places to all generations;They call their lands after their own names. [[1 Sam. 15:22]]

Nevertheless man,
though in honor, does not remain;He is like the beasts that perish. [Ex. 23:17 15:9 q Joel 1:14]

This is
the way of those who are foolish,And of their posterity who approve their sayings.Selah

Like sheep
they are laid in the grave;Death shall feed on them;The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning;And their beauty shall be consumed in the grave, far from their dwelling. [Num. 28:11] [Lam. 2:6]

But God
will redeem my soul from the power of the grave,For He shall receive me.Selah [Ps. 66:18; Is. 59:1- 3; Mic. 3:4 7 Pray] [Prov. 1:28]

For when
he dies he shall carry nothing away;His glory shall not descend after him.

Though while
he lives he blesses himself(For men will praise you when you do well for yourself), [Is. 43:26; Mic. 6:2 y Ps. 51:7; [Is. 43:25]; Rev. 7:14]

He shall
go to the generation of his fathers;They shall never see light.

A man
who is in honor, yet does not understand,Is like the beasts that perish. [Is. 40:5; 58:14; Mic. 4:4; [Titus]
